title: commiphora engleri
intro: Commiphora engleri, commonly known as African myrrh, is a species of tree in the family Burseraceae, native to southern Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to treat wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Commiphora engleri include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
